title: The Green Credits Streak
description: A college has implemented a Green Credits system to reward students for eco-friendly actions. You are given an array A of size N representing the number of Green Credits a student earned on N consecutive days. The college wants to award a special badge for the longest streak of days where the student's daily credits strictly increased. Find the length of this longest continuously increasing contiguous sub-array.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N representing the number of days. The second line contains N space-separated integers representing the array A.
outputFormat: Print a single integer representing the length of the longest strictly increasing contiguous sub-array.

title: The Missing Registration ID
description: Exactly N students were supposed to register for CodeVerse 2026, and they were assigned unique ID numbers from 1 to N. However, due to a database glitch, one student's ID was deleted from the final attendance array. Given an array arr of size N-1 containing the remaining distinct IDs, find the missing student's ID.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N-1 space-separated integers representing the remaining student IDs.

title: Sort Students by Score
description: A programming contest recorded the scores of N students. Each student has a name and a score. Your task is to sort the students in descending order of their scores. If two students have the same score, sort them in ascending alphabetical order of their names.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N. The next N lines contain a student's name followed by their score.
outputFormat: Print the sorted list of students. Each line should contain the student's name followed by their score.

title: Next Greater Element
description: You are given an array of N integers. For every element in the array, find the next greater element to its right. The next greater element for an element x is the first element greater than x that appears to its right. If no such element exists, print -1 for that position.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers representing the array.
outputFormat: Print N space-separated integers representing the next greater element for each position.

title: Minimum Latency Network
description: The campus has N buildings connected with M bidirectional fiber optic cables. Each cable has a latency value representing communication delay in milliseconds. You want to send data from building 1 to building N as quickly as possible. Find the minimum total latency required to reach building N from building 1. If it is impossible to reach, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains two integers N and M. The next M lines each contain three integers u, v, w representing a cable between building u and v with latency w.
outputFormat: Print the minimum total latency from building 1 to building N. If unreachable, print -1.

title: Scheduling the Ultimate Techfest
description: As the organizer, you have a list of N potential tech workshops. Each workshop i has a start time S[i], an end time E[i], and a Hype Score H[i]. You have only one auditorium, meaning you cannot schedule two overlapping workshops. Find the maximum total Hype Score you can achieve by selecting a non-overlapping subset of workshops. If a workshop ends at time X, another workshop can start exactly at time X.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N (number of workshops). The next N lines each contain three integers S[i], E[i], and H[i].
outputFormat: Print a single integer representing the maximum possible Hype Score.
